sentences.text: CORAM: HON'BLE MR.JUSTICE RAJAN GUPTA Present: Mr. Achin Gupta, Advocate, for the petitioner.
Petitioner is facing trial pursuant to the complaint lodged against him under Section 59(1) of Food Safety & Standard Act, 2006 Rule and Regulation 2009.

entities.text: Food Safety & Standard Act, 2006 Rule and Regulation 2009
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He absented from the court proceedings on one date of hearing i.e 14.2.2018.
Resultantly, his bail bonds were cancelled and surety bonds forfeited.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner could not appear before the trial court due to reasons beyond his control.

Petition is disposed of with a direction that in case petitioner surrenders before the trial court within a week from today and furnishes bail bonds to its satisfaction, he shall be admitted to bail on such terms and conditions as court may deem fit to impose.
(Rajan Gupta) Judge March 14, 2018 BB Whether speaking/reasoned Yes/No
